cases.purpose: Bounded independent pyte comparison: insert-delete-chars. Row 0 is not moved to the margin. A character shifted past the right margin stays off the row. pyte 0.8.0 writes that character one column past the margin and delete_characters pulls it back, so phases 2 and 3 show k at row 0 column 10. The terminal leaves a space there. Every other cell, the cursor, the size and the replies must match.

rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$rc"
/usr/bin/python3 margin-cell.py reference
